### ✨ MH Outlanders Mod Menu (v1.0.11)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)** (`com.garena.game.mho` & `com.tencent.mhadv`).

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Hunter Attack Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Multiplies EffectiveAttack, Attack, Elemental Damage & Monster HP damage dealt.
- **Hunter HP & Defense Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Multiplies Hunter Defence, ShieldValue & HealthRegen and divides incoming Monster damage.
- **Part Break & Stagger Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Multiplies Monster Breakable Part damage, clears Part Locks & speeds up Posture/Toughness breaks.
- **Always Weakpoint Hitzone (Soft Meat)** — Forces all Monster hitzones to soft weakpoint values so weapons never bounce.
- **Infinite Stamina & Weapon Energy** — Locks Stamina, Fly Stamina, JetGlider, Ultimate, Phial, GreatSword, LongSword, Bow & Charge gauges to maximum.
- **Multi-Collect / Infinite Gathering Nodes** — Resets PersonalInteractTimes & InteractedTimes to 0 on Herbs, Stones, Honey, Ore, Bonepiles & Chests.
- **Lusterwasp Pull to Hunter** — Pulls nearby Lusterwasps directly in front of your Hunter.

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
